row.scim_price_text: Free: $0/mo (up to 25,000 MAU, 1 Enterprise Connection); B2B Essentials $150/mo
row.evidence: Auth0's pricing page lists '1 Enterprise Connection', 'Self-Service SSO' and 'SCIM' as new on the Free plan, and the B2B comparison table shows Inbound SCIM 'Included' on Free, Essentials, Professional and Enterprise.
row.notes: Status changed from 'gated' to 'free'. In June inbound SCIM needed B2B Professional ($800/mo); the pricing page now lists SCIM on the Free plan (new) and the B2B comparison table marks Inbound SCIM Included on every B2B tier, including B2B Essentials ($150/mo monthly, $1,650/yr). B2C Essentials and Professional exclude it ('Upgrade to B2B to continue using EC, Self-Service SSO, and SCIM'). B2B prices are read from the pricing page's B2B toggle; the default view is B2C. Pricing is MAU-based (500 MAU at the listed B2B prices), so per-user fields stay null. Auth0 is a CIAM platform: SCIM here is inbound provisioning of a customer's workforce IdP users into an Auth0 enterprise connection, which must exist first. Management API (users, roles, logs) is on all plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 Enterprise Connection, Self-Service SSO and SCIM marked New.

plans.name: B2C Essentials
plans.notes: B2C comparison table: Inbound SCIM Not included.

scim.notes: Inbound SCIM is configured per enterprise connection (SAML, OIDC, Okta Workforce, Microsoft Entra ID); the plan must include Enterprise Connections.

auth.token_source: Dashboard: Authentication > Enterprise > [connection] > Provisioning > Sync users and groups using SCIM > Setup > Generate New Token (scoped; up to two active tokens)
auth.token_expiry: configurable: no expiration or a set number of seconds (minimum 900)

deprovision.data_retained: active=false sets the Auth0 user to blocked (profile kept); a SCIM DELETE deletes the user.

filtering.notes: Users: eq, and, or; Groups: eq. Only searchable root profile attributes can be queried.

core: any RFC 7643 core User attribute via the per-connection attribute map

custom.how: Per-connection attribute map in the Dashboard maps SCIM attributes to Auth0 root or metadata (app_metadata) fields; unmapped attributes are ignored

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute mapped to e.g. app_metadata.roles; SCIM groups can be assigned Auth0 core or organization roles

limitations.text: Okta SAML-app provisioning does not support PATCH for groups, so group size is limited to one POST/PUT payload.
Google Workspace is supported through Directory Sync, not SCIM.
Group POST/PUT with over 1,000 members omits members from logs.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event Streams deliver user and group events to a webhook, EventBridge or an Action; event names are in the Events Catalog (not loaded).

audit_log_api.plan: Free (log retention 1 day on Free, longer on paid plans)

rate_limits.text: Essentials/Professional: Read Users burst 40, 500/minute; Write Users burst 20, 200/minute.

limitations.text: assign_licenses is false because Auth0 has no per-user licence object; deactivation is via the blocked attribute.

okta.notes: OIN 'Auth0' app has only SWA and Workflows checked (read from page markup); inbound SCIM from Okta uses a generic SCIM app pointed at the connection's SCIM endpoint.

entra.notes: Auth0 docs use a non-gallery Entra app; learn.microsoft.com auth0-tutorial returns 404.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's Auth0 connector is SAML SSO (with JIT attributes); no SCIM section on the page.

conflicts.text: June row said inbound SCIM needed B2B Professional; the current B2B comparison table marks Inbound SCIM Included on all B2B tiers and the Free plan card lists SCIM. Docs only say the plan must include Enterprise Connections.

searched: https://auth0.com/pricing (B2C and B2B toggles, monthly and yearly)
open_questions: SCIM endpoint URL pattern is shown only in the Dashboard, not in docs.
ServiceProviderConfig, Schemas, ResourceTypes, Bulk and /Me support is not documented.
SCIM pagination and maximum page size are not documented.
Whether SCIM active=true unblocks a user (reactivation) is not stated explicitly.
SCIM-specific rate limits are not documented.
Whether the Free plan's single Enterprise Connection limits inbound SCIM in practice is not stated beyond the pricing card.
Auth0 Dashboard (tenant admin) members cannot be provisioned via SCIM per any doc found; this row covers inbound SCIM for enterprise connections, as in June.
